text:
Hello everyone! 
Israeli girlfriend and I have been in a long distance relationship for over 3 years and are preparing to move in together. From what we have read, we are required to have lived together and be able to provide bank statements for rent and the like. Is this necessary? We have not lived together other than a couple months in England once a year, and visits every 3-4 months for 5-10 days. Would the pictures and messages and personal bank statements showing our relationship be enough? 
Any help would be much appreciated, thank you!
